questions.q: If 2p + 1, 13 and 5p − 3 are in A.P., then p is —
questions.work:
In an A.P. the middle term is the average: 2 × 13 = (2p + 1) + (5p − 3).
26 = 7p − 2 ⇒ 7p = 28 ⇒ p = 4.

questions.q: The 9th term from the end of the A.P. 7, 11, 15, …, 147 is —
questions.work:
d = 11 − 7 = 4 and the last term l = 147.
Counting from the end, the terms go down by 4: nth term from the end = l − (n − 1)d.
9th from the end = 147 − 8 × 4 = 147 − 32 = 115.

questions.q: Three numbers in A.P. have sum 18 and product 120. They are —
questions.work:
Take the numbers as a − d, a, a + d. Sum 3a = 18 ⇒ a = 6.
Product (6 − d)(6)(6 + d) = 120 ⇒ 36 − d² = 20 ⇒ d² = 16 ⇒ d = 4.
The numbers are 2, 6, 10.

questions.q: If x + 2, 2x + 5 and 4x + 8 are in A.P., x is —
questions.work:
2(2x + 5) = (x + 2) + (4x + 8) ⇒ 4x + 10 = 5x + 10 ⇒ x = 0.
The terms are 2, 5, 8 — common difference 3 ✓.

questions.q: The number of terms in the A.P. 3, 17, 31, …, 101 is —
Which of the following is an A.P.?
questions.work:
Check the differences:
6, 7, 8, 9, 10: 1, 1, 1, 1 — equal, so an A.P.
−5, −1, 3, 8: 4, 4, 5 — not equal. a, a + b, a + 2b, a + 4b: b, b, 2b — not equal. 3, 7, 12, 18: 4, 5, 6 — not equal.

questions.q: An A.P. has sum of first three terms 18 and common difference 4. The A.P. is —
questions.work:
First three terms: a, a + 4, a + 8. Sum 3a + 12 = 18 ⇒ a = 2.
The A.P. is 2, 6, 10, …

questions.q: The common difference of the A.P. 10, 5, 0, −5, … is —
The sum of the first 20 odd natural numbers is —
questions.work:
1, 3, 5, … : a = 1, d = 2, n = 20.
S₂₀ = 20/2 [2 + 19 × 2] = 10 × 40 = 400. (In general the sum of the first n odd numbers is n².)

questions.q: Match: (i) The 15th term of 16, 11, 6, … is ____ (ii) The sum of the first 12 terms of 11, 16, 21, … is ____ — (A) −54 (B) 462 (C) 54
Fill in the blanks: (i) If a = 6 and d = 5, the 11th term is ____. (ii) The sum of the first ten terms of 7, 14, 21, 28, … is ____.
Fill in the blanks: (i) The 20th term from the end of 3, 8, 13, …, 253 is ____. (ii) If a = 5, l = 45 and the sum is 400, the number of terms is ____.
Write True or False: (i) For 10, 5, 0, −5, … the common difference is 5. (ii) 2, 2, 2, 2, … is an A.P.
questions.answer:
(i) False: d = 5 − 10 = −5.
(ii) True: each term is the previous one plus 0, so d = 0.

or.q: The 5th term of an A.P. is 23 and the 12th term is 37. Find a and d.
or.answer:
a + 4d = 23 and a + 11d = 37.
Subtract: 7d = 14 ⇒ d = 2. Then a = 23 − 8 = 15.
